concerns.text: FR‑008 (CPU‑only execution & memory ≤ 7 GB) is not covered by any task. No task records or verifies RAM usage during the pipeline, leaving the memory‑constraint requirement untested.

SC‑001 (reporting the improvement percentage of long‑term Top‑1 accuracy over the baseline) is not captured in any task or artifact. The evaluation aggregates long‑term accuracies but does not compute or store the required improvement metric.
